scope: Source audit and generated SQL structural checks; database import is not included.

observations.fact: Global text cleanup can alter string literals; removes charset/collation and index prefix lengths.
CREATE TABLE discovery uses a case-sensitive regex terminated by the first semicolon.
INSERT extraction matches a strict physical-line prefix and separator, not a SQL statement parser.
Index extraction normalizes columns/order; generated index names replace source names.
Column comments and table comments use different regexes; column escaped quotes can truncate.
Empty parser results are skipped and written to stderr without a nonzero exit; qrtz tables are skipped intentionally.
Only create, inferred id primary key, unique indexes, ordinary indexes, comments and inserts are emitted.
PostgreSQL mapping, DROP table/sequence, dual and last-INSERT-based sequence behavior.
Oracle mapping, relaxed text nullability, date-literal conversion and sequence behavior.
SQL Server mapping, forced id identity, GO batches, unicode text replacement and dual.
DM8 character-length varchar, forced id identity and identity-insert seed control.
Kingbase and OpenGauss override PostgreSQL create behavior; HighGo inherits PostgreSQL behavior.
Seven targets, optional source path and stdout-only CLI contract.
Documents simple-ddl-parser installation and printing SQL for redirection; no pinned dependency version.
Root revision, Java and Spring Boot baseline.
BOM revision and Spring Boot version.

audit_checks.method: Executed exact source functions extracted with Python AST against synthetic in-memory SQL; source project remained unchanged.
verified_cases: lowercase, indented and unquoted-table INSERT omitted
multiple INSERT statements on one line corrupted
charset and ENGINE phrases inside string literals altered
escaped single quote in column comment truncated
unsorted and multirow ids produce an incorrect original sequence start
SQL Server first string value produces malformed unicode prefix
unsupported char type raises only on PostgreSQL/HighGo and emits None on other targets

wrapper_contract.source_converter_policy: Execute the current target project's converter, not a vendored copy.
wrapper_contract.parser_logging_policy: Disable INFO and lower levels in the converter subprocess; preserve WARNING/ERROR and direct stderr diagnostics.
wrapper_contract.checks: Object inventory, INSERT statement counts, known unsupported input forms and sequence adjustment; not full SQL syntax or semantic equivalence validation.
wrapper_contract.destructive_statements_meaning: Count of DROP TABLE and DROP SEQUENCE statements only.

acceptance.other_pg_versions: Generated output and version/strategy checks only; not parsed by their server versions
acceptance.reproduction: uv run --no-project --python 3.11 --with simple-ddl-parser==1.13.0 --with pglast==6.16 python -B tests/verify_sql_targets.py --project-root <project> --output-dir <new-directory> --with-project-source --pg16-syntax-check
